candidates.desc: Doorbell camera footage shows a delivery man in a yellow hi-vis vest jogging up the path to drop off a package next to a crate of drink cans on the doorstep. Instead of just leaving it, he pulls a can out of the customer's pack for himself and sprints away down the path with it.

A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.

A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.

A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.

A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.

A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.

At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

A crowd of medieval re-enactors in helmets and tunics pours down a long grassy field toward a camp of white canvas tents. A man in full plate armour runs at the front holding a tall blue banner, and hundreds of fighters with shields and spears follow him downhill while spectators watch from behind ropes at the top of the field.

In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.

A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.

A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.
